content.title: How to watch Celtics vs. 76ers: Where to get free NBA live streams for 1st round series
content.text: Watch Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey (0) look to lead his team to an upset of Jaylen Brown (7) and the Boston Celtics, who host the series which begins on Sunday, April 19. (AP Photo/Charles Krupa)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Khadrice Rollins | KRollins@masslive.comThe Boston Celtics continue their quest for a 19th NBA championship in the 2026 NBA Playoffs, where they will open action against the Philadelphia 76ers in a first round series that started on Sunday, April 19 and continues with Game 2 on Tuesday, April 21.What Streaming Service to Use for Which Games?This year, the NBA Playoffs will appear on ABC, ESPN, NBC, Peacock and Prime Video, which means fans will need a few different services to see every one of their favorite team’s games, including the Celtics. Game 1 - ABC (Sunday, April 19 at 1 p.m. EDT)Free Options:Fans looking to watch can do so for free by using DIRECTV, which offers a free trial, or FuboTV, which also offers a free trial as well as up to $30 off your first month.You can stream ESPN Unlimited on your phone, tablet, smart TV or gaming console, and those with DIRECTV, FuboTV or Hulu + Live TV can access ESPN Unlimited through their package at no additional cost.Avoid a Monthly Subscription:SlingTV doesn’t offer a free trial but has promotional offers available for streaming the games on ABC and NBC, along with passes that allow viewers to subscribe for just one day, three days or one week instead of a full month.Game 2 - Peacock (Tuesday, April 21 at 7 p.m. EDT)Peacock has plans starting at $10.99 a month and has exclusive NBA games on Mondays and also allows fans to watch games that are broadcast on NBC. Game 3 - Prime Video (Friday, April 24 at 7 p.m. EDT)Fans looking to watch this game can do so for free on Prime Video, because it offers a free trial, along with access to exclusive NBA games as well as plenty of other content, including WNBA and Thursday Night Football NFL games, tons of documentaries across sports and a plethora of tv shows and movies.Game 4 - NBC (Sunday, April 26 at 7 p.m. EDT)Fans can use DIRECTV or SlingTV to access NBC, or watch the game with Peacock.Streaming Options for 2026 NBA PlayoffsStreaming ServiceStarting Monthly PriceFree TrialFree Trial LengthMax DiscountDIRECTV$89.99Yes5 days$40 off first monthFuboTV$55.99Yes5 days$30 off first monthPrime Video$14.99Yes30 daysN/ASling TV$45.99NoN/A$30 off first monthESPN$12.99NoN/AN/APeacock$10.99NoN/AGet 12 months for the price of 10 through annual packagesSlingTV Day Pass$4.99 (One Day)NoN/AN/ASlingTV Three-Day Pass$9.99 (Three days)NoN/AN/ASlingTV Week Pass$14.99 (Seven days)NoN/AN/AHow We Got HereRegular SeasonThe Celtics had the second-best record in the East this season at 56-26 despite being without six-time All-Star and four-time First Team All-NBA performer Jayson Tatum for 66 games. With Tatum needing most of the season to recover from an Achilles injury that ended his 2025 postseason, Jaylen Brown showed why he was a Finals MVP, averaging nearly 29 points, almost seven rebounds and five assists, leading the charge for Boston.The 76ers had the seventh-best record in the East, tied with the Orlando Magic, who they defeated in the Play-In Tournament to clinch the seventh seed. The team went 45-37 as Tyrese Maxey had a career year, finishing just behind Brown for fifth in the league in scoring as 2023 MVP Joel Embiid and nine-time All-Star Paul George played just 38 and 37 games, respectively. Embiid is currently out, recovering from an appendectomy earlier this month.Game 1The Celtics dominated the first game of the series, earning the second-biggest victory the first weekend of the postseason, and the largest victory in Celtics playoff opener history, winning by 32 points, 123-91.Brown had 26 points and a pair of steals while Tatum had 25, 11 rebounds, seven assists and two steals as well. There were four other Celtics in double figures, led by Neemias Queta with 13, followed by Sam Hauser and Payton Pritchard with 12 and Derrick White with 10.Boston had only eight turnovers while the 76ers had 14, and combined with the 16 to four 3-point disparity in the Celtics’ favor, it allowed for an easy win after picking up an early lead.Celtics lead series 1-0WATCH NBA GAMES FREE ON DIRECTV, FUBOTV AND PRIME VIDEO ALL PLAYOFFS LONGCeltics vs. 76ers 1st Round ScheduleGame (*=IF Necessary)WhenWhereTV Channel/Stream1 (Celtics won 123-91)Sunday, April 19 at 1 p.m. EDTTD Garden in BostonABC2 (Celtics Lead 1-0)Tuesday, April 21 at 7 p.m. EDTTD Garden in BostonPeacock3Friday, April 24 at 7 p.m. EDTXfinity Mobile Arena in PhiladelphiaPrime Video4Sunday, April 26 at 7 p.m. EDTXfinity Mobile Arena in PhiladelphiaNBC and Peacock5*Tuesday, April 28TD Garden in BostonTBD6*Thursday, April 30Xfinity Mobile Arena in PhiladelphiaTBD7*Saturday, May 2TD Garden in BostonTBDStream: DIRECTV (free trial); FuboTV (free trial); Prime Video (free trial); SlingTV; ESPN; PeacockBetting: Check out our MA sports betting guide, where you can learn basic terminology, definitions and how to read odds for those interested in learning how to bet in Massachusetts.Where to watch Ducks vs. Oilers free stream today: Game 2Where to watch Suns vs. Thunder free live stream today: Game 2Where to watch Stars vs. Wild free live stream today: Game 3Where to stream Magic vs. Pistons free live stream today: Game 2Where to watch Penguins vs. Flyers free live stream today: Game 3Khadrice Rollins is a sports commerce writer, specializing in professional sports, including the NFL, NBA, WNBA, Premier League, Champions League, NWSL, international soccer, MLB, UFC, WWE and more.
